|lore=“What was that?” The Jedi power known as ‘affect mind’ is often used to create minor distractions, allowing Jedi to elude enemies rather than engage them in battle.
|game_text=Plays on table. Bad Feeling Have I is canceled. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. Let Them Make The First Move may target only Undercover spies and R2-D2.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set D)]] (version 1 of 3). The image here is the slip of the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (August 2016). The current text is [[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set D) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 10, slip “•Affect Mind (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. Bad Feeling Have I is canceled. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. Let Them Make The First Move may target only Undercover spies and R2-D2.” Printed: a full slip (title bar, lore and game text, with a blank area where the picture is), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Affect Mind”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 8 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set D) (Errata)]]): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/affectmind.gif affectmind.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Bad Feeling Have I is canceled. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. Let Them Make The First Move may target only Undercover spies and R2-D2.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•Affect Mind”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set D) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/affectmind.gif affectmind.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/affectmind.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Bad Feeling Have I is canceled. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. Let Them Make The First Move may target only Undercover spies and R2-D2.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “Affect Mind”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words. The bullet is dropped from the lower-left name (“Affect Mind”). No errata mark.
|notes='''Blanked:''' The Players Committee cut this shield from Virtual Set D with [[Virtual Set 23]] on 22 July 2024: the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit lists “•Affect Mind (V)” under “Light Side – Cut”<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref>. The PC card data says its functions moved to other Defensive Shield cards. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
